A short quest in {wiki:Shadowthorn}, the elves' refuge near Venore. Go down to the cellar of the elven fortress, reach the barrel marked on the map and open it to get a {item:Heaven Blossom}.
Recommended for crossing the swamp (not mandatory)
Recommended for crossing the swamp (not mandatory)

In the swamp on the way to Shadowthorn you may meet {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Swampling|Swamplings}, {creature:Marsh Stalker|Marsh Stalkers} and maybe {creature:Water Buffalo|Water Buffaloes}.

Leave **Venore** by the city's **east** exit and cross the swamp to the **southeast** to {wiki:Shadowthorn}, the elf camp (the map shows the fastest route; there are others). A {item:Machete} and a {item:Shovel} are not mandatory, but they help you cross the swamp.
Fastest route from Venore (east exit) to Shadowthorn
Go down the staircase that is **closest** to you.
Shadowthorn map: go down the nearest staircase
Head to the spot marked with a **star** on the map.
The star marks the barrel with the Heaven Blossom
Here you only find a few {creature:Elf|Elves} and, if someone has lured one, an {creature:Elf Overseer}.
Open the {item:Barrel|barrel} to receive your {item:Heaven Blossom}.
To leave, go back the same way: return to the staircase you came down, climb it to the surface and cross the swamp again to the **northwest** to the east exit of **Venore**.
